name: Spinal Muscular Atrophy
definition: Genetic lower motor-neuron disorder, most commonly SMN1-related, producing progressive proximal weakness with variable respiratory and bulbar involvement.

investigations.principle: Genetic testing confirms most cases; respiratory and nutritional assessments guide management.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Disease-modifying genetic therapies are specialist-directed and time-sensitive.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bala/Mamsa-kshaya phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Genetic lower motor-neuron disorder, most commonly SMN1-related, producing progressive proximal weakness with variable respiratory and bulbar involvement.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for rapidly progressive weakness, respiratory/swallowing compromise, major vascular symptoms, suspected malignancy/pathological fracture, severe systemic illness or other listed red flags.
